redfin.remarks: Do not miss this beautifully appointed Westwood gem, perfectly positioned where Westwood, West LA and Century City converge! Tucked away in a secure, gated community and ideally situated on the quiet back corner, this exceptional end unit offers wonderful privacy, with only one shared wall and an abundance of natural light. Step inside to gorgeous wood floors and a thoughtfully designed floor plan. The formal dining room flows into a spacious living area with a cozy fireplace, opening effortlessly to a lush private patio —perfect for morning coffee, dining al fresco or relaxing at the end of the day. The versatile lower level offers a full bedroom and bathroom with its own exterior entry, ideal for multigenerational living, guests or a private home office. The bright, functional kitchen features abundant cabinetry and counter space, granite countertops and a separate bar area that could easily become a generous pantry. A convenient laundry closet completes the space. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedroom suites, each with a private bathroom. The primary retreat features soaring cathedral ceilings, an oversized walk-in closet and en-suite bath, while the junior suite offers wonderful natural light, ample space and its own bath. With three bedrooms and three attached bathrooms, this home offers excellent flexibility for living or income potential. Enjoy the convenience of a subterranean garage with elevator access, two tandem parking spaces and a massive private storage closet. The beautifully maintained complex has just 14 residences, with the roof and skylights replaced by the HOA within the past two years. Additional upgrades include HVAC, a dedicated garage EV charger , upgraded lighting and storage shelving. And then there is the location! Stroll to Westfield Century City or wander over to Westwood Boulevard for fantastic eateries, coffee houses and neighborhood favorites. With easy access to West LA, Century City and all the vibrancy Los Angeles has to offer, this is truly the best of both worlds—a peaceful private retreat in a wonderfully connected location!
